pages.heading: Giant Squid
pages.body: Deep oceans. A battle with a Cachalot Whale can produce a Lost Tentacle; simply killing the squid mostly yields ink. Tentacles make the Grappling Squok, which attaches to

pages.heading: Giant Squid (cont.)
pages.body: surfaces for movement. Shallow water depressurizes the squid. A lightning-struck ordinary squid can become a rare blue specimen.
